Before we finalize the launch plan, I want to make sure backend engineering, reliability, privacy, and customer success all have their chance to do their final check-in. Let's go around and hear any concerns or sign-offs from each team.

transcript.text: I need to flag a capacity concern. About 20 minutes ago, I completed a production-traffic replay and confirmed that the collaboration cluster's safe connection ceiling for Monday is exactly 6,000 concurrent connections — not the 10,000 currently in the draft plan. The autoscaling limit hasn't been updated yet because I'm still attaching the replay results to the capacity worksheet, but this needs to be corrected before we finalize.

transcript.text: I need to flag two privacy requirements from the review I completed this morning. First, collaboration content for EU accounts must remain in the EU processing region — the current draft plan stores all collaboration data in the primary production region, which would violate this. Second, session transcripts must be deleted after exactly 30 days, not the 90 days currently in the draft plan. I haven't opened the compliance ticket yet because legal was still reviewing the wording, but these need to be corrected before we finalize.
